title: Cholera epidemic: Thankfully, my family all came back cured
passage_locator: Opening epidemiological paragraph; An immediate response
supporting_summary: Reports an epidemic in Burundi since June 2019, mainly Bujumbura; also describes cases in Rumonge in January 2019.
limitation: No request identifier, submission date, dose quantity or target population linkage.

title: Tens of thousands of South Sudanese refugees receive cholera vaccine
passage_locator: Opening press-release paragraphs and campaign dates
supporting_summary: Describes vaccination in Ethiopia's Gambella region against importation risk from South Sudan; first doses 24 July-2 August 2014.
limitation: South Sudan's epidemic is not evidence of an Ethiopian outbreak; no link to the 64,335-dose request.

title: Feasibility and acceptability of oral cholera vaccine mass vaccination campaign in response to an outbreak and floods in Malawi
issuer: Msyamboza et al., Pan African Medical Journal 23:203
passage_locator: Introduction; Methods: Floods and cholera outbreak situation; Vaccine provision
supporting_summary: Documents Nsanje outbreak confirmation on 11 February 2015 and an ICG request on 6 March for 210,000 doses, approved 11 March.
limitation: DOI 10.11604/pamj.2016.23.203.8346. Matching date and quantity, but no dashboard ID is printed.

title: WHO convened cross-border meeting between Malawi and Mozambique to intensify cholera outbreak control
passage_locator: Meeting description and situation as of 25 March
supporting_summary: Describes an ongoing outbreak in both countries and Mozambique's 7,133 reported cases as of 25 March 2015.
limitation: Country/window evidence, not identification of Mozambique's April request target.

title: Oral cholera vaccine coverage during a preventive door-to-door mass vaccination campaign in Nampula, Mozambique
issuer: Sema Baltazar et al., PLOS ONE
passage_locator: Introduction: September 2015-July 2016 cases and October 2016 campaign
supporting_summary: Reports cases during September 2015-10 July 2016 and an ICG request for 425,486 doses for an October 2016 campaign described as preventive.
limitation: Dose quantity matches the August request exactly; no submission date or dashboard ID. Possible label discordance, not a proven miscoding.

title: Disease outbreak - Cholera - Mozambique - 19 February 2018
passage_locator: Paragraph describing the preceding January-April 2017 outbreak
supporting_summary: Reports a previous outbreak from January to April 2017 affecting Tete, Nampula and Maputo provinces.
limitation: Retrospective national-window evidence; does not identify the April 2017 request.

title: Nearly 900 000 doses of cholera vaccine arrive in Beira, Mozambique to support humanitarian response
passage_locator: Paragraphs on vaccine arrival, request and risk after Cyclone Idai
supporting_summary: Explicitly dates submission to 21 March 2019 and describes flood-related risk as the release rationale; reports arrival of 884,953 doses.
limitation: Two dashboard record IDs share this request date. Each records 884,975 requested doses, not the 884,953 arrivals; shipment is not requested quantity.

title: Fast roll-out of cholera vaccines for people in need in Mozambique
passage_locator: Paragraph beginning Since Cyclone Idai struck Mozambique
supporting_summary: States the Ministry declared the outbreak on 27 March 2019 and reports cases as of 8 April.
limitation: Declaration date is not first infection/onset date; no proof of absence before declaration.

title: Cholera vaccination campaign begins in Mozambique
passage_locator: Background paragraph on the last outbreak
supporting_summary: Describes the previous outbreak as ending in February 2018.
limitation: Timing differs from a March 2018 WHO bulletin listing cholera in Mozambique. Do not silently select one chronology.

title: Outbreaks and Emergencies Bulletin, Week 13: 24-30 March 2018
passage_locator: Mozambique page, Event description; author-supplied screenshot and matching transcription read on 18 October 2026
supporting_summary: The excerpt describes an ongoing outbreak in Nampula and Cabo Delgado, weekly incidence during week 12 ending 25 March 2018, and places still reporting cases as of 25 March. This establishes March 2018 activity, not a new March onset.
limitation: Full PDF was not independently retrieved. Screenshot preserved at evidence_screenshots/mozambique_who_march2018_excerpt_author_20261018.png; document-level metadata follow the landing page, not the cropped image. The northern episode is not linked to the 2019 Idai request; the February-2018 end statement in S09 remains discrepant.

title: Cholera in Niger Republic: An Analysis of National Surveillance Data, 1991-2015
issuer: Manzo et al., International Journal of Infection 4(3):e15591
passage_locator: Results 4.1, paragraph beginning Between January and September, 2015
supporting_summary: Describes 51 reported cases in January-September 2015 and specifies cases in Kollo, Tillabery and Diffa during January.
limitation: Some Diffa cases were imported; request target is not identified. Only epidemiological dates/locations used, not laboratory sections.

title: Sierra Leone
passage_locator: Programme description, emergency-response examples
supporting_summary: Mentions a response to flash floods in Freetown in 2019.
limitation: No exact month, cholera episode, request or dose quantity; flood context alone is not outbreak evidence.

title: WHO supports South Sudan in oral cholera vaccination campaign to prevent the risk of a cholera outbreak in Renk
passage_locator: Dateline 15 November; opening and campaign-schedule paragraphs
supporting_summary: Describes a risk-prevention campaign in Renk, with 280,033 doses secured and first round scheduled 18-23 November 2019.
limitation: The frozen request is 29 November for 508,784 doses. These do not establish the same request; no contemporary local outbreak is established here.

title: Ministry of Health and WHO intensify support to cholera preparedness in Sudan
passage_locator: Dateline and paragraph on possible pre-emptive OCV
supporting_summary: Describes assessment of potential cholera risk in camps and consideration of pre-emptive OCV in Sudan.
limitation: Preparedness is not a documented Sudan outbreak; no request date/ID or 260,000-dose linkage.

title: Cholera - Sudan
passage_locator: Description of the situation, opening two paragraphs
supporting_summary: Dates first detection to 28 August 2019 and describes cases through 12 October in Blue Nile and Sinnar.
limitation: Establishes national preceding-window activity, not the exact targets of each September/October request.

title: Genetic Characterization of Vibrio cholerae O1 isolates from outbreaks between 2011 and 2015 in Tanzania
passage_locator: Abstract Results, epidemiological dates only
supporting_summary: Identifies two Kigoma outbreaks in January and May 2015.
limitation: Only the historical outbreak months/place are extracted. No molecular comparisons or laboratory methods used. No request linkage.

title: WHO mobilizes 164 500 doses of oral cholera vaccine to help control the cholera outbreak in Tanzania
passage_locator: Dateline and paragraph beginning Since the start of the outbreak
supporting_summary: Reports outbreak onset on 10 May 2015 and affected refugees and Tanzanian communities in Kigoma.
limitation: Web date 17 June differs from dateline 18 June. Campaign description predates the 23 June request; no exact request link inferred.

title: Implementation research: reactive mass vaccination with single-dose oral cholera vaccine, Zambia
issuer: Poncin et al., Bulletin of the World Health Organization 96:86-93
passage_locator: PDF page 2: Setting; Decision-making and vaccine provision
supporting_summary: Dates a confirmed Lusaka case to 4 February 2016 and an ICG request to 24 March for 598,131 doses.
limitation: DOI 10.2471/BLT.16.189241. Exact date/quantity match for March, not the separate August request.

title: Ministerial statement: Outbreak of cholera and other diarrhoeal outbreaks in the country
issuer: Zambia Ministry of Health / National Assembly
passage_locator: PDF page 1, opening account of the Lusaka episode
supporting_summary: Reports a confirmed case on 29 January 2019 and further confirmed cases through 12 February; declares the Lusaka episode over.
limitation: Lusaka activity establishes a country/window mismatch, not that April or October requests targeted Lusaka.

title: Responding to Cholera Outbreaks in Zimbabwe: Building Resilience over Time
issuer: Chimusoro et al., IntechOpen; WHO and Ministry of Health authors
passage_locator: Section 4.3.2, Chegutu cholera outbreak 2018
supporting_summary: Describes a Chegutu outbreak in January 2018, with confirmation and notification during that month.
limitation: DOI 10.5772/intechopen.79794. A different locality/episode from September Harare; not request-target linkage.

title: Cholera - Zimbabwe
passage_locator: Description of the situation, opening paragraph
supporting_summary: Describes a Harare outbreak detected on 5 September and declared on 6 September 2018.
limitation: Request-month activity is not preceding-window activity; the earlier Chegutu evidence is assessed separately.

title: Cholera outbreaks in sub-Saharan Africa during 2010-2019: a descriptive analysis
issuer: Zheng et al., International Journal of Infectious Diseases
passage_locator: Methods: Cholera data and outbreak definition; Discussion limitations
supporting_summary: Uses a non-comprehensive surveillance compilation, an operational incidence threshold, and uninterrupted-reporting eligibility for main-analysis outbreaks.
limitation: External reports do not prove an error in that extraction; differing definitions and coverage remain possible explanations.

title: Cholera Outbreaks in Central and West Africa: 2018 Regional Update - Week 40
issuer: Regional Cholera Platform for Western and Central Africa / Ministries of Health
passage_locator: Page 1: Sierra Leone row, weekly column headers and suspected-case footnote
supporting_summary: Lists 37 suspected cases in W1-30 and zero in W31-38; W39-40 are NA. Does not establish a positive count in August 2018-July 2019.
limitation: No request linkage. Cumulative annual totals are not dated evidence inside the prior window; NA is not zero. The printed publication-date footer is inconsistent with the week number and is not used for event dating.

title: Cholera Outbreaks in Central and West Africa: 2018 Regional Update - Week 50
issuer: Regional Cholera Platform for Western and Central Africa / Ministries of Health
passage_locator: Page 1: Sierra Leone row, weekly column headers and case-classification fields
supporting_summary: Lists 37 cumulative suspected cases, zero at W41 and NA at W42-50; the confirmation field reports 0 confirmed.
limitation: Cannot assign cumulative cases to the audit window or infer absence from missing reports. Inconsistent printed publication-date footer retained as a source limitation.

title: Observation Collection 21445: Sierra Leone, UNICEF WCAR Weekly Cholera Reports
passage_locator: Source Documents and Observation Properties

limitation: Underlying downloadable observations were not retrieved. Catalogue totals are not independent surveillance evidence or proof of activity in August 2018-July 2019.
